title: Remove modelines in ui/qt.
description:
Remove the editor modeline blocks from the source files in ui/qt by
running

    perl -i -p0e 's{ \n+ /[ *\n]+ editor \s+ modelines .* shiftwidth= .* \*/ \s+ } {\n}gsix' $( ag -g '\.(cpp|h)' )

and cleaning up the remaining files by hand.

This *shouldn't* affect anyone since

- All of the files use 4 space indentation, which matches the default in
  our top-level .editorconfig

- The one notable editor that's likely to be used on these files and
  *doesn't* support EditorConfig (Qt Creator) defaults to 4 space
  indentation.

commits_data.title: Remove modelines in ui/qt.
commits_data.message:
Remove modelines in ui/qt.

Remove the editor modeline blocks from most of the source files in ui/qt
by running

    perl -i -p0e 's{ \n+ /[ *\n]+ editor \s+ modelines .* shiftwidth= .* \*/ \s+ } {\n}gsix' $( ag -g '\.(cpp|h)' )

then cleaning up the remaining files by hand.

This *shouldn't* affect anyone since

- All of the source files in ui/qt use 4 space indentation, which
  matches the default in our top-level .editorconfig

- The one notable editor that's likely to be used on these files and
  *doesn't* support EditorConfig (Qt Creator) defaults to 4 space
  indentation.
